verdict.rationale: Navan's Expense API documents URL path versioning (v1), states that breaking changes will ship as a new API version, and keeps dated release notes that include a concrete field deprecation and its replacement. However, it states no formal deprecation windows or sunset timelines, so the deprecation policy is only partly documented. Missing for 10: formal deprecation windows and sunset timelines, a published machine-readable spec (no OpenAPI exists), and independent or hands-on corroboration of version stability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: The API uses URL path versioning. The current version is v1
Breaking changes will introduce a new API version. Non-breaking updates (new optional fields, filters, or endpoints) can be added to current versions
